service: propagate one editorially admitted correction across every declared public carrier and the live Cloudflare publication
precondition: A source-claim supersession, withdrawal, or narrowing act identifies the affected article and exact prior publication manifest.
The corrected manuscript carries an exact accepted independent editorial judgment.
The correction transaction names the public surfaces whose bytes or semantics must change.
move: Publication Operations rebuilds and verifies the complete static candidate, records one resumable correction candidate, and contracts Resource Brokerage Team under cloudflare-primary-static-release/v1 for the exact digest.
postcondition: The article, correction register, feeds, sitemaps, NinJS, and fingerprints carry the correction and Cloudflare serves the accepted candidate; or the public site remains on the prior Cloudflare version while the exact candidate remains pending for the next operating pulse.
refusals: corrected manuscript lacks exact editorial admission
required carrier omitted or byte-identical without an admitted semantic reason
release provider refuses or cannot prove the existing Cloudflare route
excluded: Cold Red Gate HTTP origin, fallback, mirror, or rollback
using attention or revenue as factual warrant
